text.content:
It runs the city's trains, the CitiNet and the garbage. Nobody knows what it wants.

Headquarters: Night Corp HQ (#24), Downtown: a black tower with no logo and no public lobby. The CitiNet runs from the old Ziggurat tower in Japantown (#59)
Industry: Infrastructure, construction, transit, the CitiNet, sanitation, housing
Leadership: Founded by Miriam Night, Richard Night's widow
In Night City: Owns NCART (since 2068), runs the CitiNet (since 2049), holds the garbage contract and half the megabuildings

After Richard Night was murdered in 1998, his widow Miriam turned his foundation into a corporation able to stand among the megacorps. Night Corp brought the nomads in to rebuild after the 4th Corporate War and talked the city's quarreling factions into forming a new government. It keeps its structure, goals and resources secret, and its own employees know only what their jobs require.

The CitiNet

When Ziggurat lost the CitiNet contract after the Purge, Night Corp took the network over in 2049, then bought Ziggurat's Japantown tower out of the bankruptcy in 2051. It runs the CitiNet from there to this day, with NetWatch auditing it every quarter from the top floors. It logs everything, and routes Combat Zone traffic through its audit servers first. Every 8 September it throttles the CitiNet to emergency traffic for the Static Night hour.

The City

  • NCART. Bought in 2068 and run on time, which frightens people. The NCART control center is in the basement of Night Corp HQ.
  • Pacifica. During the Unification War Night Corp cut Pacifica off the CitiNet almost entirely, and it has since cut most NCART, garbage and network service there.
  • Corporate Plaza. Night Corp's second tower stands on the ring.

Nobody knows what Night Corp actually wants. Lyle Thompson calls that the most frightening sentence in his book.

Edgerunner's Handbook p.24; Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.01, 05, 06, 09
